note: Two-column page (left / right interleaved). Custodial: left MIDDLE SCHOOL (Carrier, Abare, Munro, Seguin) = middle; right ELEMENTARY SCHOOL (LeBlanc, Love, Morin) and ELEMENTARY ANNEX (Kenney) = passios (inferred from 1972 naming). Groundskeeping/Maintenance = district-wide. Cafeteria: School Lunch Supervisor (Chartrand, Office Brooks House)=central-office; SENIOR HIGH SCHOOL left column=high (Solovei, Beaulac, Blanchard, Ferguson, Rosevear, Catorio); MIDDLE SCHOOL right column=middle (Haueisen, Cook, Cote, Ewen, LaCoss, Taylor). Thibault (l18) and Winchester (l21) are right-column general workers sitting under no building heading = unknown. Role text often sits on the following line or in the other column (e.g. l19, l22, l34-39); those lines carry only tenure/role fragments. Honorifics dropped; Seguin kept 'Sr.'. Integration pass, 31 Oct 2026: school bus contractors, drivers and volunteers moved from entries to ignored (not school staff; every 1971-1980 page treated alike), and `middle` written `turkey-hill` -- the 1972 and 1974 listings print the building as `Turkey Hill Middle School (Grades 5-7)`, the town's one middle school.
